recipes.name: Savory Chicken Breasts
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Place chicken breasts in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Season with ground black pepper to taste. Top each breast with a slice of cheese.

Mix together the soup and milk and pour mixture over chicken. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top and drizzle with melted butter/margarine. Bake covered in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 20 minutes or until golden brown.

raw_recipe.headline: Savory Chicken Breasts
raw_recipe.description: Oh so creamy under that crumb topping! Chicken blessed with Swiss cheese and a subtle cream sauce.

video.description: Baked chicken with a crumb coating and a creamy surprise.

review.reviewBody: This turned out GREAT but I did make some modifications. Substituted muenster for the swiss, increased milk to 1/2 cup, and added 1/4 c. dry sherry to the soup/milk mixture. Sprinkle chicken generously with garlic powder, poultry seasoning and some black pepper before placing cheese on top. Pour sauce mixture evenly over and then top with 1 1/2 cups Stove Top Stuffing mix(chicken flavor) mixed with melted butter. Followed baking directions as written. Sprinkled some grated parmesan over the top for last 5 minutes of baking. Also, using lowfat evaporated milk is a great way to cut some fat and get a real creamy result.

I made this recipe substituting Healthy Request Campbell's Cream of Chicken Soup and bread crumbs made from crushed Garlic & Butter Seasoned Croutons. I gently pounded the chicken breasts with a meat tenderizer hammer to make them of equal thickness. The chicken breasts were moist and delicious!

This is a variation of a recipe that my family has been making for years. We use cream of mushroom soup and mix in a 1/2 a cup of white wine. So first the chicken breasts (cut into quarters) and swiss cheese on top and then pour on the soup/wine combo and instead of topping with bread crumbs, mix a melted stick of butter or margarine with the bread crumbs in a chicken stove top stuffing recipe and put on top. Cook at 325 F for one hour and a quarter to one hour and a half. Amazing with cranberry sauce and broccoli or carrots - a mini Thanksgiving dish!

I altered the recipe based upon earlier reviews. Instead of water, I used all beef broth. Also, I browned the chicken breasts in butter in a skillet first, then sautéed mushrooms with some garlic before putting everything together into the pan and then into the oven. Basically, the dish turned out well, but, if I were to do this again, I would omit the breadcrumbs, as they didn't seem to add much. I served the chicken with sautéed spinach, but next time I will use something different because the spinach didn't seem to complement the dish.

Second time making this dish and it is just as yummy! I followed other suggestions - I seasoned the chicken with seasoned salt, pepper and garlic powder. I added provolone cheese and shredded mozzarella on top of chicken. I used 3 cans of soup, as we wanted extra gravy for the side of garlic mashed potatoes. I used Stove Top stuffing mixed with French's Fried Onions and melted butter. Covered with foil and baked for 35 minutes, then removed foil and cooked another 15-20 minutes. It has definitely been added to the weekly meal rotation!

Excellent! Best baked chicken I ever tasted. However, I put twice as much Swiss cheese on it and Ii spiced up The Panko crumbs i used with onion powder and garlic powder. And added The melted butter to the crumbs before I sprinkled them on top. Made it lot easier. And I used chicken thighs. I did make extra sauce also with a large can of cream of chicken soup. So it did take a bit longer to do the initial baking I set the timer for 45 minutes and that was just dry for the first bake. From now on I will always bake chicken this way it is perfect and tender couldn’t ask for a better chicken.

Delicious! Moist, tender, fragrant and best of all...so easy. I did read the reviews and made a few excellent alterations. I seasoned the chicken with poultry seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper. I added the butter to the bread crumbs and used a can of cream of chicken and a can of cream of mushroom. 1 cup of milk and 1/2 cup of white wine. Cooked it for 55 minutes and PERFECTO! This will be my go too recipe when I'm at a loss for what to make. I'll try this with noodles next time.

I was so excited to try my first recipe. I did this with a few adjustments and only because I did not have all of the ingredients listed at the time. I substituted the condensed cream chicken soup with Continental’s Creamy Chicken Soup in a cup. I added a tablespoon of cornflour to the mixture to thicken the sauce a bit. I also used Panko breadcrumbs instead of plain breadcrumbs. Unfortunately I had to bake it without the foil because I had none left ??. Turns out covering the dish with foil is an important step because the chicken did end up a little bit dry. I followed everything else and was so thrilled to have a yummy homecooked meal that was so easy to make! My family loves it. I’ll be making this again for sure. Thanks so much for sharing!

Made this as a base for supper tonight and we all loved it I added some diced onions, mushrooms and fresh green beans to the pan around the chicken before pouring the sauce over. I also added about a 1/4 cup of lightly crushed French’s Crunchy Onion toppers to the breadcrumbs. Cooked as indicated and served with mashed potatoes, yum!

This dish was really good! I made a few changes...I didn't have swiss cheese so used cheddar instead, sprinkled 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder and juice from 1/2 lemon over chicken, mixed soup with 1/4 cup of white wine and 1/4 cup milk to pour over chicken. Topped it with a package of chicken dressing mix. Yummy...A keeper.

I’ve been baking this dish for years. I first started with just the dry bread crumbs. But the original recipe is a bit bland with just pepper. I use pepper,salt and garlic and rub it all over the chicken. I use shredded Swiss cheese or sharp cheddar. I use the soup and milk and pour that over. Sometimes I use cream of mushroom. But on top I’ve been using Stove Top Dressing for chicken. I drizzle more than 3 tablespoons melted butter. Maybe twice that. I bake it the same way. It’s so much more flavorful that dry bread crumbs. Yo can also use Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix as well. Excellent base recipe so I give it 5 stars! I don’t think it’s fair when people change the recipe and then give it less than 5 stars.
Was excellent everyone loved it i did use stovetop instead of breadcrumbs and added garlic to the butter
I saved this recipe 9 years ago and have made many times over the years. It's become my family's favorite. No alterations made. So quick and easy to throw together.
Made using several of Valerie’s recommendations but used Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing since Stove Top is no longer available here. Delish!

My husband loved it. I used a little more seasoning on chicken - whatever seasoning made by Tonya. I used it on the seasoning on the chicken and the garlic and herb breadcrumbs. I did not cover with aluminum foil at all. I increased milk to 1/2 cup and added 1/4 cup more breadcrumbs. The flavor was fabulous, and I will make this again. I want to try the stuffing next time.

It was used for inspiration- I turned it into stuffed breasts~ Swiss , dabs of cream cheese, green onion,chopped frozen tomato,asparagus,chopped red grapes, chopped green olives- sat on chopped onion, added some lemon juice also. First heavily seasoned with a couple chicken seasonings,pepper. Garlic,chili flakes…. 💖

I varied a bit as well. I didn't have bread crumbs so I topped it w crushed lemon/lime tortilla chips. to the soup mixture I added some dried onion and garlic
 the only thing I'd change next time is adding the cheese to it at the end. great recipe.. everyone loved it
Recipe is great without any changes
Delicious, I doubled recipe. Next time I'll increase cheese and milk to make more sauce.
Always a favorite bake. I cook as describe and only sprinkle with parmesan during the last 10 minutes.
